title: Vampire Vape Applelicious 10ml E-Liquid
description: If you love sweet and sour apple flavours, then you should get your hands on Vampire Vapes Applelicious E-Liquid. Each puff of this drool worthy Applelicious E-Liquid delivers a rush of sweet and tangy sour Apple Candy with notes of real juicy apples for a mouth-watering intense vape. That’s not all to look forward to. The aroma of the vapour is quite simply divine. With each mouth-watering puff you will be able to immerse your senses with the aroma of a sweet apple orchard paired with the great taste of sour apple. This E-Liquid from Vampire Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please note: that the 3mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 0mg, 6mg, 12mg & 18mg nicotine strengths contain 40VG/60PG. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits. If you love this delicious Vampire Vape E-Liquid 10ml, then why not check out the other equally moreish flavours from their collection. They have a multitude of delicious flavours to choose from to suit any vaper’s flavour requirements. Go ahead and try out their juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverage , sweet bakery, confectionary and dessert flavours or even their classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours.
